title: Meetings & Events Banquet Fee Schedule: Bar, Corkage, Cake, Overtime and Ceremony
content:
Banquet billing prices the items outside a Meetings & Events package from this schedule. Amounts are in US dollars and are stated per package.

## Bar service

| Package | Each additional hosted bar hour, per billed attendee | Fee per bartender | Billed attendees per bartender assigned |
|---|---|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 (no bar offered) |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 (no bar offered) |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 (no bar offered) |
| Social Reception Package | 14.00 | 175.00 | 75 |
| Wedding Celebration Package | 12.00 | 175.00 | 75 |
| Conference Plenary Package | 0.00 | 175.00 | 100 |

## Outside wine and outside cake

| Package | Client may bring own wine | Corkage per 750 ml bottle opened | Client may bring a cake from an outside baker | Cake cutting, per billed attendee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | No | 0.00 | No | 0.00 |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | No | 0.00 | No | 0.00 |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | No | 0.00 | No | 0.00 |
| Social Reception Package | Yes | 35.00 | Yes | 4.00 |
| Wedding Celebration Package | Yes | 35.00 | Yes | 5.00 |
| Conference Plenary Package | No | 0.00 | No | 0.00 |

## Overtime and ceremony

| Package | Fee per hour of function space use beyond the package hours | Most overtime hours that may be booked | Ceremony site fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | 150.00 | 2 | 0.00 |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | 250.00 | 2 | 0.00 |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | 250.00 | 2 | 0.00 |
| Social Reception Package | 500.00 | 2 | 0.00 |
| Wedding Celebration Package | 750.00 | 2 | 1500.00 |
| Conference Plenary Package | 1000.00 | 3 | 0.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

- A figure of 0 billed attendees per bartender means the package offers no bar.
- Outside wine and outside cakes are permitted only under the Social Reception and Wedding Celebration packages.
- The Conference Plenary Package is the only package allowing 3 overtime hours; all others allow 2.
- The ceremony site fee appears only under the Wedding Celebration Package.
